Sentiment analysis (also known as opinion mining) refers to identifying subjective information within text data sources like social media posts , reviews on products/services etc., then classifying these into positive/negative categories based upon their tone/attitude towards something specific being discussed therein - e.g.: “I love Apple’s new iPhone!” vs.” This latest version has too many bugs”.
